title: Report
description:
The report envelope: the complete analysis output carrying facts and diagnostics.

Five fields, exactly in this order (order is part of the byte-stable contract): 1. `schema_version` — the contract version (serialized from SCHEMA_VERSION constant) 2. `tool_version` — the CLI/engine release (injected by the CLI at runtime) 3. `analyzed_at` — RFC 3339 timestamp (injected by the CLI at runtime, excluded from determinism tests) 4. `findings` — the facts discovered during analysis 5. `diagnostics` — records of what analysis couldn't determine

Both `findings` and `diagnostics` are always present as arrays (never null, never omitted), expressing the contract's invariant shape: an empty-detector run still produces a well-formed report.

schema_version.description: Schema version (e.g. `"0.1.0"`), serialized from `SCHEMA_VERSION`. Used by consumers to enforce compatibility bounds.

tool_version.description: Tool version: the CLI/engine release that produced this report. **Not populated by the `json` crate.** Injected by the CLI at runtime. Many tool versions may share one schema version.

analyzed_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when analysis completed. **Not populated by the `json` crate.** Injected by the CLI at runtime. String (not a chrono type) to keep the `json` crate free of time dependencies and to keep the contract format-explicit. Excluded from determinism tests (analysis output may vary by timestamp).

findings.description: The facts discovered during analysis. Empty array is valid — an empty-detector run still produces a well-formed report.

diagnostics.description: Records of what the analysis couldn't determine (errors, warnings). Empty array is valid. Never null or omitted.

Finding.description: A Finding: one structured fact with provenance and confidence. The `data` field is an open JSON object for per-kind payloads, allowing detectors to grow schema additively without editing the contract.

category.description: Which category of question this finding answers.

kind.description: The specific fact type within the category (e.g. "cargo-toml"). A string, not an enum — the load-bearing extensibility choice.

path.description: Repo-relative path this fact is anchored to (forward-slash normalized). `None` for genuinely repo-global facts.

data.description: The typed-per-kind payload as an open JSON object. v0 enforces it is always a JSON object (never a bare scalar or array). Per-kind payload shapes are tightened in Phase 5/6.

provenance.description: Which detector produced this, and from which files.

DetectorCategory.description: The six stable detector categories from the architecture. Serialized as kebab-case strings for human-legible, language-neutral JSON.

oneOf.description: Version sources: tags, branches, manifest versions.

Confidence.description: Confidence level of a finding. A small closed enum: exactly three levels. Variant order is meaningful: `Low` < `Medium` < `High` (derives `Ord`). Serialized as lowercase strings to ensure determinism and stability.

oneOf.description: Low confidence: the finding may be correct but has significant uncertainty.
Medium confidence: the finding is likely correct but uncertain.
High confidence: the finding is almost certainly correct.

Provenance.description: Provenance: which detector produced a finding and from which sources. Makes facts traceable to bytes on disk.

sources.description: Repo-relative, slash-normalized paths the fact was derived from. May be empty for synthesized facts (Phase 2+).

Diagnostic.description: A diagnostic: a record of something the analysis couldn't determine. Diagnostics capture the "why couldn't you find that?" context.

message.description: Human-readable message explaining what couldn't be determined.

detector.description: Which detector produced this diagnostic (stable id).

path.description: Optional path this diagnostic is anchored to (repo-relative, forward-slash normalized). Always emitted (as `null` if absent) to maintain invariant report shape.

Severity.description: Severity level of a diagnostic message.

oneOf.description: A warning that analysis continued despite an issue.
